options.text: Do you have anything to trade?

steps.player: Do you have anything to trade?

steps.npc: No, I'm sorry.

steps.text: If the player has become unrated as a White Knight

steps.npc: Well, maybe I do, but you need to prove yourself worthy as a White Knight before I will sell you anything.

steps.player: And how can I do that?

steps.npc: Kill Black Knights and make sure you don't kill any White Knights!

steps.text: If the player is a Novice rank white knight

steps.npc: You are currently at Novice level within the White Knights, so your access to equipment is limited.
I can sell you a White Knight Chainmail body for 1440 coins, and White Platemail legs for 1920 coins.

steps.prompt: What would you like to buy?

steps.text: If the player is a Peon rank white knight

steps.npc: You are at Peon level within the White Knights, not much to choose from I'm afraid.

steps.text: If the player is a Page rank white knight

steps.npc: You've reached Page level, that shows a bit of dedication you know! Your available equipment will reflect that!

steps.text: If the player is a Noble rank white knight

steps.npc: And may I say what a pleasure it is to serve any Knight who has achieved Noble level!

steps.text: If the player is an Adept rank white knight

steps.npc: And it is so very rare that I see any White Knight who has reached Adept level!

steps.text: If the player is a Master rank white knight

steps.npc: Well of course! I AM the White Knights armourer after all!
And for a dedicated White Knight to have reached Master level like yourself, you get only the very best of all equipment available!

options.text: Why are there so many knights in this city?

steps.player: Why are there so many knights in this city?

steps.npc: We are the White Knights of Falador. We are the most powerful order of knights in the land. We are helping the king Vallance rule the kingdom as he is getting old and tired.

options.text: Can I just distract you for a minute?

steps.player: Can I just talk to you very slowly for a few minutes, while I distract you, so that my friend over there can do something while you're busy being distracted by me?

steps.npc: I'm... not sure what you're asking me... you want to join the White Knights?

steps.player: Nope. I'm just trying to distract you.

steps.npc: ... ...you are very odd.

steps.player: So can I distract you some more?

steps.npc: ... ...I don't think I want to talk to you anymore.

steps.player: Ok. My work here is done. 'Bye!

crack-the-clue-iii.npc: Excellent work! I have new information to share with you.

crack-the-clue-iii.text: You've found a new special clue! However, a magical force prevents you from putting this item in your inventory!
Interface showing the next clue opens.

treasure-trails-hard.npc: You're not done yet! Do this for me!

treasure-trails-hard.text: Sir Vyvin has given you a puzzle box!

treasure-trails-hard-while-holding-the-p.text: If the puzzle is not solved:

steps.npc: The black knights can do puzzles better than that!
Excellent work!

steps.text: Sir Vyvin has given you another clue scroll!

steps.npc: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
Your commitment to the white knights is fantastic [player name].

You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.

treasure-trails-master.npc: Your commitment to the white knights is fantastic [player name].
